signature: prototype wiring (overlays, back/esc, flows, hover) missing from the skill
symptom: Building the Lede dashboard's Prototype page needed overlays, Esc to close, flows and hover states; the skill had no helpers or docs for them, so a session wrote them ad hoc in a scratchpad lib.js.
reason: setReactionsAsync, flowStartingPoints and CHANGE_TO were usable but undocumented (api-unknown): __fx.react / overlayFrame / flow, references/prototyping.md and gotcha 17. Probes also found api-limit parts (overlayPositionType, overlayBackground and overlayBackgroundInteraction read-only and silently ignored; overlayRelativePosition needs MANUAL) and api-plan-limited parts (SET_VARIABLE, CONDITIONAL, a second variable mode refused on the free plan), documented with the full-size overlay workaround.
